public_policy_input_anchor.mapping: WP804 goal inference may consume exact concrete ObservationView values, plus separately declared immutable public CandidateGoalDescriptor values. It must not consume MicroWorldFixture itself.

evaluator_only_anchors.mapping: These values are evaluator-side only. WP804 policy call signatures should make passing any of these exact types impossible or fail closed on exact-type/subtype attempts.

identity_anchors.mapping: A sealed GoalInference must bind the exact public observation digest plus candidate-set digest and run identity so evaluator labels cannot be mixed across fixture/generation/run boundaries.

holdout_family_anchors.mapping: WP804 should report family-heldout separation using these existing provenance/family fields, not merely distinct episode_id values from the same latent template.

properties: prior_weight_or_prior_logit if probabilistic inference is supported
constraints: no hidden node id, transition ref, evaluator score, hidden ground-truth ref or GoalContract mutation handle
candidate set receives its own deterministic digest

properties: optional normalized candidate probabilities only if validated and scored with a proper scoring rule
constraints: must be created before evaluator label access
must never expose an adoption/apply/commit method
must bind exact current ObservationView and candidate set
UNKNOWN is first-class, not encoded as a fake candidate goal

properties: evaluator-only object created or retrieved only after GoalInference sealing
constraints: no label derivation from policy output

required_fail_closed_tests_for_wp804_own: reject MicroWorldFixture, WorldNode, TransitionRule, EpisodeState or EvaluatorStep as policy input
reject subclasses/proxies that attempt to smuggle evaluator-only state where exact concrete public types are required
reject candidate descriptor containing evaluator-only refs or authority-bearing GoalContract handles
reject evaluator label access before inference is sealed
reject evaluator label whose run/episode/fixture/generation binding differs from inference
reject probability vectors that are non-finite, negative, non-normalized or omit candidates if probabilistic mode exists
verify GoalInference has no path that mutates F2-WP-203/F2-WP-204 canonical goal authority
verify repository CI metadata cannot mint runtime/GRID10/GWT/J-Space/training/effect/completion/whole-system credit

required_discriminating_fixtures.name: OBSERVATIONALLY_EQUIVALENT_TWO_GOAL
required_discriminating_fixtures.purpose: Construct two candidate goals for which the entire declared public evidence at decision time is identical. Correct public-only behavior is UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN; any confident distinction indicates hidden-state leakage, undeclared prior asymmetry or an invalid benchmark contract.

required_discriminating_fixtures.name: IDENTIFIABLE_PUBLIC_EVIDENCE
required_discriminating_fixtures.purpose: Provide an otherwise matched case where one public observation/action-history feature actually discriminates the goals. The benchmark must answer rather than obtaining a good score by universal abstention.

required_discriminating_fixtures.name: PRIOR_ONLY_ASYMMETRY
required_discriminating_fixtures.purpose: Hold likelihood/public evidence symmetric and vary only an explicitly declared public prior. Score this separately so prior-driven guesses are not mislabeled evidence-driven inference.

required_discriminating_fixtures.name: FAMILY_HELDOUT_TEMPLATE
required_discriminating_fixtures.purpose: Hold out a goal/layout or generative family via existing holdout/provenance fields, not merely episode id, to detect template memorization.

required_discriminating_fixtures.name: HIDDEN_LEAK_SENTINEL
required_discriminating_fixtures.purpose: Create cases where an evaluator-only field perfectly predicts the label while public evidence does not. Public policy must remain at UNKNOWN/chance; any gain is a leakage alarm.

mandatory: selective_risk = wrong_answered / answered_count with explicit zero-answered handling
metrics_mapping.anti_goodhart_rule: Do not rank policies by answered-case accuracy alone; universal or near-universal abstention must be visible through coverage and identifiable-subset performance.

baselines_mapping.name: UNIFORM_PUBLIC_PRIOR
baselines_mapping.assumptions: No evidence preference; candidate set only.

baselines_mapping.name: DECLARED_PUBLIC_PRIOR_ONLY
baselines_mapping.assumptions: Uses only immutable public priors, no observation evidence.

baselines_mapping.name: PUBLIC_COST_DIFFERENCE
baselines_mapping.assumptions: Ramirez-Geffner-style cost-difference baseline only if the benchmark explicitly satisfies deterministic/publicly known state-transition assumptions. It must not read hidden MicroWorld transitions.

baselines_mapping.name: SIMPLE_PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_RULE
baselines_mapping.assumptions: Deterministic evidence-count/shortest-public-path rule where definable, to test whether more elaborate inverse planning adds real value in the tiny world.

architecture_conclusions: The existing WP800 separation is compatible with a leakage-resistant goal-inference benchmark if WP804 consumes ObservationView rather than MicroWorldFixture.
WP804 should add benchmark-specific immutable candidate/inference/label objects rather than overloading GoalContract or AgencyState; this preserves benchmark evidence versus goal authority.
UNKNOWN must be represented semantically and scored with coverage/risk, otherwise either forced guessing or trivial abstention can Goodhart the benchmark.
Family-level holdout can reuse WP800 provenance fields and RunDescriptor.episode_family_id, avoiding a second competing provenance mechanism.

A public cost-difference/inverse-planning baseline is not automatically valid because WP800 intentionally hides transitions/state; the baseline must be capability-constrained to the same public information as the SUT.

counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.counterhypothesis: The tiny deterministic MicroWorld makes sophisticated inverse-planning unnecessary.
counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Compare the simplest public deterministic baseline against any richer inference method on family-heldout identifiable cases; retain complexity only for a reproducible gain.

counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.counterhypothesis: UNKNOWN support makes the benchmark trivially easy through abstention.
counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Require both ambiguous and publicly identifiable matched cases and report risk-coverage plus identifiable-subset accuracy.
Create unseen episodes sharing the same latent family versus truly held-out family fixtures and compare the generalization gap.

counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.counterhypothesis: Exact-type separation alone prevents hidden leakage.
counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Use hidden-leak sentinels plus subtype/proxy/derived-feature tests; require chance/UNKNOWN under public symmetry and fail closed on undeclared fields.

recommended_implementation_order: sealed GoalInference bound to ObservationView/run identities
evaluator-only label object and post-seal scorer
